tool_args.rationale: Pilot signatures and archive note point to sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation. Short-H observations are all positive and provide no evidence for the long-horizon reversal. A slow-horizon probe is explicitly needed before fitting and can distinguish this mechanism from the short-window alternatives.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon 5-parameter law using only the five short-H rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows cover only H=0.16–0.48 and cannot identify the long adaptation timescale or establish the predicted reversal at the requested H=22.5.
Targets ODE trajectory fitting; the candidate dual-horizon law specifically calls for a long-horizon discriminating observation.
Does not resolve the key short-versus-long horizon ambiguity.
